Lastly, your guardian is your father, which is less common among students who pass, as many have their mothers as guardians. This may indicate a difference in support dynamics that could affect your academic performance.

To improve your chances of passing, consider increasing your study time and seeking additional educational support, as most students who succeed tend to engage more actively in their studies. Additionally, discussing your academic challenges with your father or seeking help from teachers could provide you with the guidance you need to enhance your performance. Taking these steps can help you build a stronger foundation for your final year and reduce the likelihood of needing remedial courses.
